primal_precision_summary.scope: eta64 is FP64 arithmetic only; final same-direction JVP difference is an observation,not a global NN bound

outward_tilt_growth_cost.no_new_policy_input_scope: This existing outward term is unchanged relative to v12; the new forward-excess term is declared separately and adds no policy input.
outward_tilt_growth_cost.state_tilt_margin_source_scope: Unchanged kernel source constant; AST-bound, not a runtimecfg parameter getter.

episode_force_credit_policy.scope: Bounded fixedworld+.3directflat; independent firstepisode gate unchanged, not automatic stairs reuse.

task_context.velocity_point: robot.data.root_link_lin_vel_w; root rigid-body link origin, not body COM or whole-body COM
task_context.velocity_frame: yaw-only Rz(root_yaw).T times world velocity; XY in m/s
task_context.goal_frame: yaw-only Rz(root_yaw).T times world+X unit vector; XY
task_context.eligibility_timing: stored previous-control qualification at preaction; after true reset use that new episode; never future force
task_context.schema_bootstrap: explicit constructor-only flag and common_step_counter==0; closed after base constructor
task_context.context_block_normalization_owner: learning/evaluation entry, separate from old frozen prefix

optimizer_path_semantics: All actual split PPO/RND optimizer tensors are inside this same complete checkpoint.
rnd_semantics: Weight0 means no intrinsic reward; actual fresh predictor Adam and normalization continue and are checked.

rollback_equivalence.scope: Current packet digest binds the prior unique whole-state/GPU RNG comparison; that comparison is not rerun.
